faq.footer: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out — we usually reply within a few hours.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Marketing sites: 3–5 weeks. E-commerce platforms: 6–10 weeks. Custom ERP and complex web apps: 10–16 weeks. We share a precise timeline after the discovery phase.

items.q: Do you work with international brands?
items.a: Yes — we work with clients from around the world. Our team operates remotely and on-site as needed, with bilingual delivery in English and Arabic.

items.q: What stack do you build on?
items.a: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Framer Motion, Node, and custom integrations. For ERP we tailor the stack to your operational complexity. We pick boring, reliable technology that scales.

items.q: Do you handle design as well as development?
items.a: Yes. We handle brand strategy, UI/UX, motion design, engineering, QA, and launch. One contract, one team — accountable end to end.

items.q: What does post-launch support look like?
items.a: Monthly retainers cover bug fixes, performance monitoring, content updates, analytics review, and roadmap planning. Most clients stay with us for 12+ months after launch.

items.q: Can you take over an existing project?
items.a: We can audit your codebase, design system, and infrastructure, then continue iterating. Many of our biggest wins start as rescues of stalled or underperforming products.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the information you share with us. This policy explains what we collect through this website, how we use it, and the rights you have.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you contact us through the form on this site, we collect the name, email address, service interest, and message you choose to provide. We do not ask for payment details, government identifiers, or other sensitive personal data through this website.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use the details you submit solely to respond to your enquiry, prepare proposals, and communicate about a potential or ongoing project. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to anyone.

sections.heading: Email delivery
sections.body: Messages sent through the contact form are delivered to our business inbox by email. Handling of that email is subject to the security and privacy practices of our email provider.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep enquiry correspondence for as long as it is needed to serve you and to satisfy our legal and accounting obligations. You may ask us to delete your correspondence at any time.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: This website uses no advertising or tracking cookies. We store a single preference in your browser to remember the theme you chose, light or dark. That preference never leaves your device.

sections.heading: Data security
sections.body: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect the information you send us. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of the personal information you have shared with us. To exercise any of these rights, email us at digitivaa@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Third-party links
sections.body: Our site links to client projects and social platforms that we do not control. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or the content of those external sites.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy as our services evolve. The revision date shown at the top of this page always reflects the version currently in effect.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: If you have any question about this policy, email digitivaa@gmail.com and we will respond as soon as we can.
